Had an amazing experience with Ladakh Himalayan Exposures
during our Ladakh trip! The entire journey was very well planned, from transportation to stays and sightseeing. The team was professional, friendly, and always ready to help, which made the trip smooth and stress-free.

Special thanks to the Javed bhai, Pankaj bhai and our Marshall jacky who ensured our safety and comfort throughout the challenging mountain roads. Visiting places like Pangong Lake and Umling La became even more memorable because of their excellent coordination.

Highly recommended for anyone planning a Ladakh adventure — reliable service, great hospitality, and unforgettable memories! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Had an incredible experience with the entire team during our Ladakh expedition. From day one, they treated us less like customers and more like family. The professionalism, care, and honesty shown throughout the trip made a huge difference.

A special thanks to Waseem (owner) for managing everything so smoothly and always ensuring the group was comfortable and safe. Huge appreciation as well for Javed, who drove the backup car and was always there whenever support was needed, Pankaj for handling the bikes and mechanical issues so efficiently, and Jahangir, our marshal, who guided us throughout the journey with great patience and experience.

What truly stood out was how they handled difficult situations. One of my friends unfortunately met with an accident during the trip, and the team immediately stepped in, supported him, and ensured he was properly taken care of. Another friend faced low oxygen issues at high altitude, and the way the team handled the situation calmly and responsibly was commendable.

They were also very honest and practical while guiding us during off-roading and biking stretches — clearly explaining what should and shouldn’t be attempted for our safety instead of just encouraging risky activities. That level of responsibility is rare.

Ladakh is beautiful, but the people managing your journey matter just as much. Huge thanks once again to Waseem, Javed, Pankaj, Jahangir, and the entire crew for making this trip memorable, safe, and special. Highly recommended to anyone planning an adventure in Ladakh.

Great experience overall, the arrangement was awesome, warm hospitality and good adventure for once in a lifetime experience, would be happy to take the next trip again in future! Keep up the good work! @Waseem @Asif @Javed @Jehangir !

Thank you guys for some of my BEST days ever! ⭐️

I am a solo traveller and rented a bike for 3 days. They provided a good bike and a great service. Even asked me to stop by to change the brakes for me for free after my first day.

No hidden feed and when I returned the bike they did not go overboard looking for anything to scratches or anything to charge me with they were just happy me and the bike was safe.

Can recommend them highly from my experience.

NOTE: For inexperienced drivers like myself just know that the mountain roads there are quite challenging with alot of blind turns and big trucks. And also that the height can make you light headed. So I recommend be 100% comfortable with driving a motorbike before you take on the mountains!
